title: The Osirion at Abydos predates Seti I

tellings.quote: I don't believe that the Osirion was created by STI. I think it's far older than STI.

plain: At Abydos in Egypt there is an ancient stone structure called the Osirion, which sits beside the temple of the pharaoh Seti I. Luke Caverns, a researcher speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, says he does not believe Seti I built it and thinks it is far older. If so, it would mean someone built it long before the Egyptians usually credited with it.
